name: Simple Category List
author: nziniwal

sections.description:
Simple Category List helps you create beautiful, customizable lists of categories, tags, and taxonomy terms without writing code.

Whether you’re building a WooCommerce store, blog, directory, portfolio, or custom WordPress website, the plugin makes it easy to display taxonomy terms exactly where you need them using flexible shortcodes and reusable presets.

🍻 Enjoying the plugin? You’ll find an optional “Buy the Developer a Beer” support box inside the Category Lists admin page.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce product categories
  • WooCommerce product tags
  • Blog categories and tags
  • Custom post type taxonomies
  • Directory websites
  • Portfolio websites
  • Landing pages
  • Page builders that support shortcodes

Features

  • Create and manage multiple category lists
  • Display lists using simple shortcodes
  • Support for WooCommerce taxonomies
  • Support for WordPress categories and tags
  • Support for custom taxonomies
  • Custom titles for each list
  • Exclude specific terms
  • Reusable presets with unique IDs and slugs
  • Flexible design controls
  • Custom colors and spacing
  • Adjustable heading levels
  • List marker customization
  • Responsive output
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • Translation ready
  • Works with most WordPress themes
  • Compatible with page builders that support shortcodes

Shortcode Examples

Display a list by ID:

[category_list id="2"]

Display a list by preset slug:

[category_list preset="featured-categories"]

Display the default list:

[category_list]

You can also override saved settings using shortcode attributes when needed.

Supported Taxonomies

The plugin works with virtually any public WordPress taxonomy, including:

  • category
  • post_tag
  • product_cat
  • product_tag
  • Custom taxonomies registered by themes or plugins

Why Use Simple Category List?

Unlike many category listing plugins, Simple Category List focuses on simplicity, flexibility, and ease of use.

Create multiple reusable category displays, customize their appearance, and place them anywhere on your site using shortcodes—without touching code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the categorylist folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Open Category Lists from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create your first category list.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode and place it anywhere on your website.
sections.faq:
Where are the category lists managed?

All lists can be managed from the Category Lists menu in the WordPress admin area.

Can I create multiple lists?

Yes. You can create and manage as many category lists as needed.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin fully supports WooCommerce product categories and product tags.

Does it support custom taxonomies?

Yes. Any public taxonomy registered in WordPress can be used.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes. It works with page builders that support WordPress shortcodes.

Is coding required?

No. Everything can be configured through the admin interface.
